Sure — apologies for the short reply. My notes (two bullets):
- Andre leaned on caching to solve cross-region consistency without fully addressing stale-read scenarios; seemed to underweight read-after-write constraints when we discussed multi-master flows.
- When I pressed on failure modes, responses were reasonable but centered on retries rather than isolation/circuit-breaker patterns, which worried me for user-facing endpoints.

I'm comfortable reconciling on the 11:30am PT slot — I put a short justification in the scorecard next to the system design cell. If after the sync Neha/Tessa still feel strongly Hire, I'm ok moving to hiring committee with comment that Marissa wants follow-up questions at on-site.
